about: The Home Tour (Jay, Nov 18): after the tutorial floor's Floor Keeper, Sensei walks the student round their Home Dojo, out into the town and back to the training station. One sentence a line. DRAFT words (from docs/tutorial-design.md part C), placeholders until Jay approves them. {player} = first name, {dojo} = the real dojo's door label in the town.
dojo: Welcome home, {player}! This dojo is yours.
Keep it clean and make it your own. You'll earn things to decorate it.
station: This is your Training Station. It takes you back to the Tower.
toTown: Come, let's see the town. Walk out the door.
realDojo: That's {dojo}, our real dojo. Train there and you grow strong here too!
goHome: Let's go home. Walk to your door.
toStation: Ready? Walk to your Training Station.
boardOpen: Climb whenever you like. I'm proud of you!
